mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_health_profile ( user_id, height_cm, weight_kg, age, activity_level, disease_history, profile_goal, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{age}, #{activityLevel}, #{diseaseHistory}, #{profileGoal}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE height_cm = VALUES(height_cm), weight_kg = VALUES(weight_kg), age = VALUES(age), activity_level = VALUES(activity_level), disease_history = VALUES(disease_history), profile_goal = VALUES(profile_goal), updated_at = NOW()
